fit: Reuse frozen AE/scaler. Fit mean squared reconstruction residual per channel using all 3638 Train ADL windows only, B=1 float32 residual and float64 accumulation. channel: inverse channel means; stream: inverse means of first/last256 channel means. Floor max(1e-12,0.1*median(positive channel means)); normalize weights to mean1; score mean(weight*squared_residual) float32. No additional AE epochs.
fixed: Original30/stride1 Human512 features, observed poses, quality .2/9/.8, K3, same split. Validation balanced_sequence_accuracy threshold, fewer FP then higher threshold.
selection: Eligible rows ranked operational_accuracy, sequence_fall_f1, end_to_end_fall_recall, fewer FP; baseline wins ties.
guard: No Accuracy/F1 regression, no extra unknown or early coarse event; at least baseline2 coarse phase-hit sequences. Every newly detected original FN must have a valid current-pose visible suspected_fall window inside its prelocked coarse fall phase.
stop: Exactly two profiles; no additional weighting powers, floors, quantiles or threshold objectives after Validation. Test once only if selected profile passes targets and guard. No post-Test tuning.
